narrative.overview: A calm in-game menu rendered in pastel. Surfaces are frosted glass with a lit top edge, panels are cut on one diagonal the way Wuthering Waves cuts its own, and controls are soft pills. Everything is quiet: small uppercase accent headings, pale tinted fills, thin borders, generous padding. It is a lookup tool used beside a running game, so the page recedes and the facts carry the colour.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass for the nav, cards and callouts only. Long lists get the lit edge and shadow without the blur.
Chamfered panels (two opposite corners cut) and pill-shaped controls.
Small, uppercase, letter-spaced accent headings instead of large black ones.
Colour is data: rarity, Echo cost and Sonata piece count each have a fixed scale reused everywhere.
Light by default, with a true dark counterpart; palette-agnostic by construction.

rules.name: The Palette Is Not Ours Rule
rules.body: Never write a hex in a component. Derive shades with color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent). The five palettes and the player's custom colours are the source of truth.

rules.name: The Ink On Tint Rule
rules.body: On an --accent-soft or --lemon-soft background, text is --accent-ink or --lemon-ink, never the raw accent.

rules.name: The Three Scales Rule
rules.body: Rarity, Echo cost and piece count are different numbers with different colour scales. Do not reuse one scale for another.

rules.name: The Quiet Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are small, uppercase, letter-spaced and accent-coloured, not large and black.

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Every text colour clears 4.5:1 on the surface it sits on, at 12px, in all palettes and both modes.

rules.name: The Only Eleven Rule
rules.body: Blur is for the nav, cards and callouts. Never the 61, 114 or 187 row lists; no tab blurs more than eleven elements.

rules.name: The No Glass Without Fallback Rule
rules.body: Browsers without backdrop-filter, and players with prefers-reduced-transparency, get the opaque surfaces back.

dos: Do write every colour as a token and derive tints with color-mix (Palette Is Not Ours Rule).
Do test any new screen on Forest & cream and Amber & slate, in dark mode, and at 375px.
Do put small facts in pill badges with a tinted background, a matching 1px border and bold ink text.
Do keep copy short and specific, with no em dashes: "17 builds want this", not "popular choice".
Do declare color-scheme per theme so dialogs, scrollbars and form controls follow dark mode.
Do keep motion on one scale (--fast 140ms, --med 240ms, --ease cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)) and let prefers-reduced-motion zero the durations rather than delete the rules.
donts: Don't hardcode a hex in a component, or add Tailwind, shadcn or a utility-class layer.
Don't blur the long lists, or put overflow-x: auto on a block whose glow must show without padding it back out.
Don't cut all four corners of a panel.
Don't use --text-faint below 13px or --accent as text on an accent tint.
Don't make headings large and black, or anything loud.
Don't put a transform on an ancestor of a background-attachment: fixed element.
